reconcile.note: Gill limits the absolute without-a-parable claim to that particular sermon, noting Jesus spoke plainly both before and after it.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible notes that John's Jesus delivers long discourses yet never once tells a parable, the opposite of the absolute claim in Matthew and Mark.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible, "Did Jesus always speak in parables?"

sides.snippet: without a parable, he didn't speak to them,
sides.verseText: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn't speak to them,

sides.snippet: Without a parable he didn't speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained all things.
sides.verseText: Without a parable he didn't speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained all things.
